items.title: Rusty Dedrick interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: my brother-in-law’s widow is married to Hoagy Carmichael’s stepson. Clear as mud, right? But so we share that.

ctx.x: Wow. Some interesting chords there at the end.

Thank you. The reason for my picking this is not because of the musical content over any of the other things, but, now I hope I can get this straight, my brother-in-law’s widow is married to Hoagy Carmichael’s stepson. Clear as mud, right? But so we share that. But I loved Hoagy Carmichael, he wrote so many great things, and he never got, I think, the commercial recognition. I mean “Stardust” of course, but so many other tunes that nobody, a lot of people don’t know about.
He went all the way back to Bix’s days too.
